violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Chislic that was cut, portioned, then stored in a freezer were date marked at time of preparation. They have been pulled and thawed ready for use in the food truck. That date mark should reflect when they were thawed out. -Blocks of sliced cheese were found stored in a zip log bag without a date on them.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -There is a noticeable build-up of dust and debris around the interior of the food truck. The floors should be swept and cleaned more frequently.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. - Broken jug of ranch was sitting in handwashing sink.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory * was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. - No soap for hand washing.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --No Sanitizer for dishwashing. Did have sanitizer wipes, but using the scented wipes. Use only non scented wipes.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Overall floors, walls and ceiling need cleaning.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. - Fly control is an issue with this mobile. Fly strips can be used as long as they arent over or in proximity to food.
